name: Executive VIP Transfer Service
author: Gksoft Dev Team

sections.description:
⚠️ WooCommerce is required.
This plugin relies on WooCommerce to process bookings and manage orders.

Executive VIP Transfer Service is a professional booking system for chauffeur, limousine, and VIP airport transfer businesses.
Customers can easily book rides using Google Maps distance calculation, while admins manage prices, vehicles, and locations directly from the dashboard.

✨ Free Features

  • Customizable transfer booking form
  • Google Maps Distance Matrix API integration
  • Distance-based price calculation
  • Address autocomplete with Google Places API
  • Automatic booking & tracking page creation
  • WooCommerce order integration
  • Modern responsive front-end form
  • Admin configuration panel:
    • Country — Restrict autocomplete suggestions to a selected country
    • Currency — Display prices with local symbols (€, $, ₺ etc.)
    • Per-Km Pricing — Define cost per km
    • Minimum Service Price — Set minimum booking cost
    • Maximum Distance (km) — Prevent long-distance bookings
    • Contact Number — Displayed for customer communication

💎 Pro Features

Upgrade to Pro Version for advanced business features:

  • 🚗 Vehicle management (brand, capacity, image)
  • 🕒 Pickup date & pickup time options
  • 🧭 Priority support

The Pro version unlocks premium modules, including vehicle manager and schedule picker.
Works seamlessly with the free core plugin — just activate your license key.

🧰 Requirements

  • WordPress 5.6+
  • PHP 7.2+
  • WooCommerce active
  • Google Cloud APIs enabled (and a valid API key):
    • Maps JavaScript API
    • Places API
    • Distance Matrix API

💡 Tip: Restrict your API key by HTTP referrer and set daily limits for security.

Shortcodes

  • [execvitr_form] — Displays the transfer booking form.

The Order Tracking page is created automatically (execvitr-tracking).
Customers are redirected there with a secure, time-stamped link after placing an order.
(There is no separate tracking shortcode.)

How It Works

Upon activation, the plugin automatically creates:
– A Booking Form page with [execvitr_form]
– A Tracking page for order lookup

Customers can:
– Enter pickup & drop-off addresses (Google Autocomplete)
– View price estimates instantly (km-based)
– Choose vehicle (Pro) and schedule date/time (Pro)
– Complete payment via WooCommerce checkout

Admins can:
– Add/manage vehicles (Execvitr Cars, Pro only)
– Configure API key, pricing, currency, and country restrictions
– View/manage all bookings in WooCommerce Orders

Privacy

This plugin uses the Google Maps JavaScript API and the Distance Matrix API solely to calculate distances and travel times.
No personal analytics or tracking is performed.

Data collected during checkout follows your site’s WooCommerce privacy policy.

  • Google Maps Terms of Service
  • Google Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is active.
  2. Upload and activate the plugin.
  3. Go to VIP Transfer Service → Settings to configure Google API key, currency, and pricing.
  4. Use the created Booking Form page or insert [execvitr_form] anywhere.
sections.faq:
Why is my price different from Google’s route estimate?

Your rate is based on custom per-km pricing and minimum service fee, not on Google’s driving data.

The autocomplete doesn’t work.

Ensure your Google API key is valid, APIs are enabled, and the key is restricted to your domain.

Can I use different currencies per country?

Currently, a single currency is set globally (configured under Settings → Currency).
